activity_summary: At supper you paid threepence. You told the house the post was damp, that the knife went in two inches, and that the ground falls back to Giles Allen on the thirteenth of April, 1597. You named no price. You said you would give two mornings in March and leave the law to the family. Master Verbeke sat at the table and did not speak. The Sunday letter stayed folded for Thursday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported a damp post, two mornings, and no price, and kept the letter as it was.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Took threepence, refused another man's lease as kitchen business, and stopped the lost wife at the door of the plot.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether the house would come down, and dusted round the letter without opening it.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Sat at the table when damp was mentioned, and did not speak.

facets.activity: Told the house the post was damp

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The post is damp. That is the news.
